inspiration.observed_pattern: A scalar INET6_NTOA(INET6_ATON(...)) composition canonicalizes one IPv4 text value.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one fixed IPv4-mapped address and a HEX projection of its binary encoding, removing table state and multiple address families while retaining the nested conversion contract.

fixture_notes: The IPv4-mapped address must canonicalize to ::ffff:192.0.2.44 and retain its 16-byte packed representation.
determinism_notes: The address literal is fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.

steps.sql: SELECT INET6_NTOA(INET6_ATON('::ffff:192.0.2.44')) AS canonical_address, HEX(INET6_ATON('::ffff:192.0.2.44')) AS packed_hex
